query: I was walking my golden retriever puppy this morning and he stopped to sniff a whole patch of wild strawberries growing by the sidewalk, he even tried to nibble one and it was so cute I had to stop and take three different videos of him to send to my sister. After that I popped into the little corner café on my way home and got their new lavender honey iced latte, it’s way better than I thought it would be, they even put a tiny edible flower on top as a garnish. I also remembered I need to pick up a new pack of dog chew toys later today because he destroyed his last one last night trying to play tug of war with the couch cushion. Anyway, I was hoping you could help me figure out why my phone can’t connect to the mobile network at all right now. I checked and airplane mode is turned on, my APN settings seem to be acting up, I think my line might be suspended because I have an overdue bill and my contract just ended, and I wonder if the SIM card might have come unseated too.
